text: Next in our series Real Worlds, we travel inward to Neptune's largest moon, Triton — a captured Kuiper Belt cousin of Pluto that orbits backwards and erupts active geysers on a frozen nitrogen crust at minus two hundred and thirty-five degrees Celsius.
